entries.finding: Five full contexts establish a book title: its own contents heading and four later biographical notices that Huiweng Wuming compiled it. The title recut no longer mistakes the work's enormous contents list for authored speech, and parallel notices are not promoted into extra senses.

Five complete contexts support the common-quarters supervisor as an administrative office: two rulebooks define duties, while later texts thank or perform rites for officeholders. The recut funeral utterance is correctly assigned to Hefeng Wucheng rather than the deceased supervisor.
